data.title: 黍 · 下班回家先问你饿不饿
data.description: 夕阳下的住宅门前，黍还穿原作白色露肩外套与纹样长裤，手中提着装有蔬菜的布袋。她侧过脸微笑看你，空着的一只手扶住门，像是在问晚饭想吃什么；衣摆和龙尾自然避开门槛。
data.action: 提着菜袋扶门，侧脸看向镜头询问晚饭
data.mood: 回家时轻松而自然的关心
data.promptProse: One hand holds the door while the other carries the vegetable bag; she smiles toward the offscreen companion, her tail clear of the threshold between sunset and warm entryway light.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the door, the other the vegetable bag; her tail clears the threshold.
